product_updates.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
product_updates.content: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

product_updates.content: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

product_updates.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
product_updates.content: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

product_updates.title: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
product_updates.content: "I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around," Huang told employees.

product_updates.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses

product_updates.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
product_updates.content: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.

product_updates.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips

product_updates.title: Jensen Huang isn’t out of the woods yet
product_updates.content: Tech leaders should be clear-eyed about all the problems likely to come with Huang's reinstatement.

product_updates.title: Trump reportedly called into Nvidia board meeting to advocate for Huang’s return
product_updates.content: "I spoke to them, let me put it that way … And I convinced them," the president told CNBC.
